segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I am lost.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Tôi bị lạc.] [EN: With.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Với.] [EN: These days, lately.] [PAUSE 3s] [VI: Dạo này.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chồng.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Husband.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Here is a key rule: in Vietnamese, the adjective comes AFTER the noun, not before. Beautiful is] [VI_F: Đẹp.] [EN: a high, rising tone. So a beautiful house is, literally, house beautiful.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nhà đẹp.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Big is] [VI_F: Lớn.] [EN: small is] [VI_F: Nhỏ.] [EN: a falling, rising tone. A big house, a small house.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nhà lớn, nhà nhỏ.] [EN: New is] [VI_F: Mới.] [EN: a high, rising tone. A new car —] [VI: xe mới.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xe mới.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill, noun then adjective. A beautiful house.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nhà đẹp.] [EN: A big house.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nhà lớn.] [EN: A small house.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nhà nhỏ.] [EN: A new car.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xe mới.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Nhỏ.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Small.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Mới.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: New.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Nhà anh lớn không?] [VI_M: Dạ, nhỏ thôi. Nhưng đẹp.] [VI_F: Vậy hả.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say, a beautiful house.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nhà đẹp.] [EN: Say, a new car.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xe mới.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you learn to say how much. The preview word is] [VI: rất] [EN: which means very.]
